Name: Contract: Void Justice
Overview:
Contract: Void Justice is a sci-fi third-person shooter which can be played in single and multiplayer (2 player co-op) modes. Players take on the role of a mercenary who has just delivered a prisoner to the space prison ship PPG-871. When prisoners escape during a blackout and begin rioting, the mercenary is hired by the warden to kill the rioters.

The objective is to kill all the enemies on a given level, and players are equipped with both a gun and a sword for this purpose. Money collected by killing enemies can be spent on items at a shop such as a compass and a level map.
